comparison.advmoe_first_order: clean route margin divided by the L1 norm of its gradient with respect to unit-pixel input
comparison.advmoe_pgd_extrapolation: attack epsilon divided by achieved fractional margin compression
comparison.rt_er_reference: aggregate median of the exact box-capped unit-pixel route radii over 20 official constructions and 10000 inputs

interpretation: All AdvMoE radii are empirical local/extrapolated estimates, not reachable witnesses or certificates. The RT-ER denominator is exact in its registered pixel-box semantics. Their ratio is an architecture-regime diagnostic, not a controlled causal estimate.
